semiconductor_relevance: Low — the Michigan Economic Development Corporation primarily focuses on economic development and business support rather than direct semiconductor manufacturing or services.
summary: The Michigan Economic Development Corporation (MEDC) supports business development and economic vitality in Michigan, promoting the state as an attractive location for various industries, including semiconductor-related businesses. They offer consulting services and financial incentives to companies considering expansion into Michigan.

regional_presence.United States: MEDC actively works to attract businesses to Michigan, providing support for companies looking to expand in the region.
